name: mcp-forge
description: Turn any OpenAPI spec into a working MCP server — give Claude tools for any REST API in 30 seconds, zero codegen.

scripts.smoke: node -e "import('./dist/index.js').then(async m => { const fs=await import('node:fs/promises'); const spec=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('examples/petstore.json','utf8')); const t=m.openapiToTools(spec); console.log('tools:', t.map(x=>x.name).join(', ')); console.log('base:', m.getBaseUrl(spec)); })"

author: Neil Gilani
